# Coco Chess Engine 2.0.0 technical reference

Coco is a free, GPL-3.0 C++20 UCI engine for standard chess and Chess960,
maintained by NotKaede-11.

## Installation

Download a Coco executable for your operating system and CPU. Add it as a UCI
engine in a chess GUI such as Cutechess or Arena. For Chess960, select the
variant and load a Chess960 starting position in the GUI. The engine supports
the `UCI_Chess960` option.

- [Download and setup](https://notkaede-11.github.io/coco-engine-website/#downloads)
- [Common questions](https://notkaede-11.github.io/coco-engine-website/#faq)

## Board and evaluation

- Bitboards represent the position. Magic tables handle sliding attacks,
  with a BMI2/PEXT build available.
- Chess960 uses rook-origin castling rights, position hashing, and the
  UCI king-to-rook castling encoding when UCI_Chess960 is enabled.
- Every release executable embeds the unchanged Ravager v3 weights. The
  evaluator has 1,024 accumulator units per perspective, mirrored king
  buckets, threat and pawn-pair inputs, and material output buckets.
- Thanks to erensh27 for the network and evaluator. Component licenses and
  Calvin-informed search and clock policy credits are in the source notices.

## Search and time

- Principal variation search with iterative deepening, aspiration windows,
  a transposition table shared by Lazy SMP workers, and optional Syzygy probes.
- Coco 2.0 moves eligible transposition-table cutoffs earlier, adds four-ply
  continuation history for quiet move ordering, and uses targeted reductions
  with verification or depth restoration in selected lines.
- With a low clock, preserve time to deliver the last completed best move.
  If no depth completes, return a legal fallback.

## Published ratings and local match

- [CCRL 40/15](https://computerchess.org.uk/4040/cgi/engine_details.cgi?print=Details&each_game=0&eng=Coco%201.5.0%2064-bit#Coco_1_5_0_64-bit): Coco 1.5.0 scored 3027 (±50 over 98 games).
- [CCRL Blitz](https://computerchess.org.uk/404/cgi/engine_details.cgi?print=Details&each_game=1&eng=Coco%201.5.1%2064-bit#Coco_1_5_1_64-bit): Coco 1.5.1 scored 2986.
- [Chess Engines Diary](https://chessengines.blogspot.com/2026/10/the-102026-season-of-chess-engine.html?m=0): Coco 1.5.1 appeared at 3165 in the October 2026 qualifiers at 3+3.
- [Coco 2.0 local match](https://github.com/NotKaede-11/Coco-Engine/blob/v2.0.0/CHANGELOG.md#200): The 2.0 build scored 98.00% against Coco 1.5.1 over 1,000 standard-chess games at 10+0.1. This match ran before the low-clock fix.
